line: Crowley's Atu I: the letter Beth, Mercury, and the path from Kether to Binah, under a chapter heading that differs from the card's name.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: The Key Scale prints The Magus and Crowley's chapter is headed The Juggler; his list of titles gives The Juggler. The attribution to Mercury is the same either way.

quotes.quote: I. to XXI. The Juggler; The High Priestess; The Empress
This card is referred to the letter Beth, which means a house, and is attributed to the planet Mercury.

sections.title: Its path on the Tree
sections.line: Mercury is the path from Kether to Binah, which Crowley also states in his appendix. The Key Scale gives path 12.

quotes.quote: But Mercury is the Path leading from Kether to Binah

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: Crowley's description of what the card stands for.

quotes.quote: This card therefore represents the Wisdom, the Will, the Word, the Logos by whom the worlds were created.
Mercury, however, represents action in all forms and phases.
In this card, the emphasis is upon the creative and dualistic character of the path of Beth.
